messages.title: Daily Inspiration
messages.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
messages.translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.

messages.title: Verse of Comfort
messages.translation: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
